title: Disney announces a global deal with TikTok to bring "thoughtfully curated" fan-created short-form videos based on Disney's IP to Disney+'s vertical Verts feed (Brooks Barnes/New York Times)
summary: Brooks Barnes / New York Times: Disney announces a global deal with TikTok to bring “thoughtfully curated” fan-created short-form videos based on Disney's IP to Disney+'s vertical Verts feed — Disney said it would allow “thoughtfully curated” fan-created videos, using clips from its library, to appear on the streaming service.
contentText:
Brooks Barnes / New York Times :

Disney announces a global deal with TikTok to bring “thoughtfully curated” fan-created short-form videos based on Disney's IP to Disney+'s vertical Verts feed   —  Disney said it would allow “thoughtfully curated” fan-created videos, using clips from its library, to appear on the streaming service.
